## Checklist

- [ ] One resource per pull request (or a small group on one theme)
- [ ] The link opens, and it is the specific page (a book's own page, not a publisher's home page)
- [ ] Legal source, no pirated PDFs
- [ ] Not already in [all-resources.md](../all-resources.md)
- [ ] Format: `- [Name](https://link) - Description. *Access.*`, description in English, ends with a full stop
- [ ] Original name kept, English translation in brackets if needed
